correctness.rationale: Wang–Wang–Teng's publisher PDF confirms model (1.1), Table 3's stated hypotheses, the separate uniqueness sentence before Theorem 2.1, and local asymptotic stability in Theorem 2.1(ii). The function h is smooth on I≥0, h(0)=0 and h'(0)=1; h(I) lies between I/4 and I, and h'≥1/9 follows from 8(1+I)^3−54I=2(2I−1)^2(I+4). Use N=S+V and W=S−V. Then W'=−(1+h/10)W, N'=96−(1+h/10)N and I'=Nh/10−3I. At I=0 the source formula gives R0=16/5. Eliminating N gives 96h/(10+h)−3I, exactly the stated rational function. Its three simple positive roots lie in (0,2), at 2, and in (2,21), respectively. Here S=V>0 and N+I=96−2I<96 so all three are inside the source's invariant region. At I=2, W=0, N=90, h=2/3 and h'=5/9. The (N,I) block has rows (−16/15,−5),(1/15,2), trace 14/15 and determinant −9/5, giving (7±sqrt(454))/15; the W eigenvalue is −16/15. Thus the middle point is a saddle. The source uses a derivative-to-ratio comparison which fails here, with its l̂33 equal to −2. The bundled checker was inspected only; it uses sp.N for some sign checks, but exact inequalities above justify those signs. This refutes the stated deterministic uniqueness and stability conclusions only.
